caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, elaborately carved wooden wall clock with dark reddish-brown tones. The clock face, located in the upper third of the clock, is circular with black Roman numerals and black clock hands indicating the time as 4:19. The clock face is bordered by a gold frame with decorative flourishes in the corners. Below the clock face, there is a rectangular glass panel with a faint, misty blue and gray tint. The lower third of the clock features a decorative, framed painting of a yellow bird perched on a branch with pink flowers and green leaves, bordered by a zigzag yellow and black trim. The overall composition is centered on a plain, off-white or beige background, and the artist's signature "Anna M. Gully '86" is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Shelf Clock
